usedFor: A “New Client” in Advogalia updates that person's contact record in HubSpot.

bestTemplate.name: “New Client” in Advogalia, then “Update Contact” in HubSpot
bestTemplate.why: The action finds the contact by email, so no duplicate record is created.

watchOut: “Update Contact” matches on email, so the person must already exist in HubSpot with that address.
